sql: SELECT p1.ProductName as product1, p2.ProductName as product2, count() as times_together FROM retail.FactOnlineSales s1 JOIN retail.FactOnlineSales s2 ON s1.SalesOrderNumber = s2.SalesOrderNumber AND s1.ProductKey < s2.ProductKey JOIN retail.DimProduct p1 ON s1.ProductKey = p1.ProductKey JOIN retail.DimProduct p2 ON s2.ProductKey = p2.ProductKey GROUP BY p1.ProductName, p2.ProductName ORDER BY times_together DESC LIMIT 20
